name: Dinhata

queries.query: Dinhata West Bengal official cadastral parcel map land records government
queries.result: Found the official West Bengal BanglarBhumi land-records portal, which advertises RS-LR plot information, plot maps, mouza maps, and mouza-map availability. Official Cooch Behar district pages identify the Dinhata Sub-Divisional Land & Land Reforms Office and Dinhata land-administration hierarchy. Direct anonymous retrieval of the official portal timed out during this attempt; no parcel API response or geometry was obtained.

queries.query: দিনহাটা পশ্চিমবঙ্গ সরকারি দাগ খতিয়ান মানচিত্র ভূমি রেকর্ড
queries.result: Search surfaced the official BanglarBhumi portal's Bengali/English land-record service surface and its plot/mouza map services, but did not produce a Dinhata-specific public parcel response. No geometry or native parcel identity was obtained.

registryEvidence: Official Cooch Behar district sources identify the Sub-Divisional Land & Land Reforms Officer, Dinhata, and a Dinhata office notice refers to Kamtapur Mouza in Dinhata-I Block. The official BanglarBhumi portal identifies the state land-record custodian and offers plot and mouza map services. This evidences a local registry/custodian and procedure, not open parcel geometry coverage.
